facts.fact: On 2022-09-08 Benin's Minister of Digital Affairs and the Director General of the Smart Africa Alliance signed a memorandum (protocole d'accord) launching the Smart Africa Digital Academy (SADA) in Benin; the ministry calls Benin an active member of the Alliance.
The article of 2022-09-08 states that the first SADA training courses in Benin, on cybersecurity and artificial intelligence, had already started.

systems.owner: Smart Africa Alliance with Benin's Ministry of Digital Affairs
